entries.text: How are you liking Levincia? Business and tech\nare what we pride ourselves on!
entries.label: c03_south_01

entries.text: The city’s main street is just north of here!\c\nNothing says “Wow, I’m in Levincia!” like being\nslapdab in the middle of all those neon signs.
entries.label: c03_south_13

entries.text: Since we wear socks day in, day out, they just\ngotta be comfy as can be!
entries.label: c03_south_37

entries.text: I don’t care if a bag can’t fit much inside, as long\nas it’s stylish!
entries.label: c03_south_38

entries.text: So this is Iono’s Gym... I’ve seen it in her videos\nso many times—I can’t believe I’m actually here!
entries.label: c03_south_39

entries.text: Did you see the latest episode of Iono Zone?\nThat collab with Tulip was great!
entries.label: c03_south_43

entries.text: Iono’s super cute, isn’t she? She’s the most\npopular streamer around, hands down!
entries.label: c03_south_44

entries.text: Having greenery around the city is good for our\nwell-being. Sure helps me feel less stressed.
entries.label: c03_south_56

entries.text: Life in Levincia is exhilarating. There’s always\nsomething going on!
entries.label: c03_south_57

entries.text: Right! Ultra Balls—you got it!\c\nYup, they outperform Great Balls on all counts,\nso I’ll go ahead and put in an order for 300!
entries.label: c03_south_85

entries.text: When I grow up, I wanna be an inflooenser too!
entries.label: c03_south_86

entries.text: You can make a living doing all sorts of things\nthese days!
entries.label: c03_south_87

entries.text: I went to make a sandwich, but I’d run clean out\nof picks! Would you believe it? I go through ’em\r\nso fast, I’d better buy ’em in bulk from now on.
entries.label: c03_south_127

entries.text: I could go for the Treasure Eatery in Medali, but\nCascarrafa’s Kofu Lounge also sounds good.\r\nShould we call a Flying Taxi?
entries.label: c03_south_147

entries.text: I’m headed out to catch Pokémon later, so I want\nto eat something that’ll give me Catching Power!
entries.label: c03_south_148

entries.text: I’m gonna wait till that Pokémon’s flying riiight\nover the ocean, and theeen...SNAP!
entries.label: c03_center_06

entries.text: There’s boats ’n’ stuff down there! I wish I could\nsail to the bottom of the sea!
entries.label: c03_center_30

entries.text:
Levincia feels nice and safe thanks to all the
security cameras about the place!\c
I hear the footage they capture is used for the
Gym Test.
entries.label: c03_center_39

entries.text: Pottery classes in Alfornada—I’m telling you,\nthat should be our next big project!
entries.label: c03_center_51

entries.text: Livestreamed Pokémon battles can be fun to\nwatch, but I want to see them in person, too!
entries.label: c03_center_65

entries.text: Ryme’s new track just dropped! I gotta check it\nout ASAP!
entries.label: c03_center_69

entries.text: Everything in Tulip’s limited-edition line of\nmakeup is so lovely! I’m spoiled for choice!
entries.label: c03_center_70

entries.text: These skyscrapers are crazy tall! My neck hurts\njust trying to take ’em all in!
entries.label: c03_center_73

entries.text: Apparently, all five of these buildings are owned\nby a real estate firm called Paldea Realty.
entries.label: c03_center_74

entries.text: This city’s electricity is generated by a species of\nPokémon called Tadbulb! What hard workers!
entries.label: c03_center_78

entries.text: M-my idol! He’s on the neon signs!!! He pops up\non one screen, then the next...then ANOTHER!\r\nOooh, Brassius...I’m your biggest fan!!!
entries.label: c03_center_79

entries.text: You can use a TM Machine to create any TM that\nyou’ve ever gotten before!
entries.label: c03_center_90

entries.text: If you had a Pokémon you could ride over water,\nyou could leap into the ocean without a care!
entries.label: c03_center_99

entries.text:
Levincia started out as a port town that shipped
ore from the mines to various other places.\c
It’s hard to believe that humble port went on to
become the high-flying business hub it is today!
entries.label: c03_center_100

entries.text:
Where did the name Levincia come from? Is it
from that old word “levin”? Or “leviathan”?\c
Or maybe, ’cause the city has all these soaring
buildings in its Million Volt Skyline, could it be
from “leaven”? Like, you know, rising bread?
entries.label: c03_center_110

entries.text: You remember that famous professor? Haven’t\nseen h[VAR 0x1107(00FF,0202)]erim on TV or in the papers for a while...
entries.label: c03_north_21

entries.text: I heard [VAR 0x1107(00FF,0001)]she has some sort of lab at the base of\nthe lighthouse over by Cabo Poco.
entries.label: c03_north_22

entries.text:
Changing up your look also changes up your
whole mood!\c
Your day can go all sorts of ways depending on
the clothes you wear.
entries.label: c03_north_28

entries.text: OK, we got Potions, sandwich ingredients,\nPoké Balls... Hope we didn’t forget anything!
entries.label: c03_north_40

entries.text: We can always take a Flying Taxi back to the\nPoké Mart if we need to.
entries.label: c03_north_41

entries.text: [EMPTY 44]
entries.label: c03_north_42

entries.text: Iono started out as a streamer quite a few years\nago now... Just how old is she, anyway?
entries.label: c03_north_71

entries.text: My Luxio’s fur has a nice sheen to it, huh?\nI always give it a wash first thing after a battle.
entries.label: c03_north_75

entries.text: One day, when I’m all grown up and rich, I’ll say\nto the shop man “I’ll take the lot!”
entries.label: c03_north_79

entries.text: *munch munch*\c\nI heard the Levincia Gym livestreams the Gym\nTests of all its challengers!
entries.label: c03_north_86

entries.text: *gulp gulp*\c\nI watched the Gym’s livestream of a Trainer\nnamed Nemona. Her Pokémon were awesome!
entries.label: c03_north_87

entries.text: I heard the academy has mountains of books!\c\nWhen I start studying there, I’m gonna read every\nsingle issue of Occulture!
entries.label: c03_north_95

entries.text: If you climb the lighthouse up ahead, you’ll get\na great view over the whole city of Levincia!
entries.label: c03_north_103

entries.text: I like photos of scenic places as much as anyone,\nbut the most memorable photos for me are\r\nalways ones of people or Pokémon.
entries.label: c03_north_106
